component.name: PulsarKey
component.summary: Hardware-backed FIDO2 and Biometric PAM Authentication Manager for COSMIC

description.p: PulsarKey is a native Rust security utility designed specifically for Pop!_OS COSMIC desktop. Named after celestial neutron stars that rhythmically pulse across the cosmos, PulsarKey connects the pulsing LED of your FIDO2 key (such as YubiKey C Bio) with zero-lag lockscreen unlocking, biometric sudo authentication, and real-time top panel monitoring.

ul.li: Native COSMIC Panel Status Applet with real-time hardware connection monitoring
Instant biometric unlock on lockscreen (with Space+Enter activation to eliminate greeter lag)
Passwordless or touch-confirmed sudo privilege escalation
One-click biometric sensor testing and diagnostic notifications
Full automated setup, key enrollment, and clean uninstallation

description.p: Initial release of PulsarKey featuring COSMIC Greeter support, YubiKey C Bio hardware user verification, and StatusNotifierItem desktop panel applet.
